text:
Maya: Quick midnight rollout update — starting 00:15 UTC. I flipped feature flag `smart_cache` for slice=alpha (5%) and kicked off the canary. Observability looks green so far. Ping me if you see anything odd. @Hassan can you watch logs?

DeployBot: deployment started for rollout id r-20260317-01, canary=5%, target instances=24.

Hassan: Saw a couple of 503s around 00:18 on svc-infer-02, but they were short lived and didn't correlate with higher latency. Investigating; initial signs point to transient gRPC backpressure. I added a transient retry in the gateway and watching.

Sara: FYI the canary bundle includes quantized model v2.1 — perf baseline looks stable. I ran a short load pass earlier: p95 token latency ~120ms, quality check samples passed.

Jordan: Left a tiny CR on the rollout helper — bumping healthcheck timeout 1s -> 2s to reduce noisy alerts. Not blocking: https://git/repo/pull/394

Maya: Thanks. Current blockers: none. Plan: wait 30m, if no regression we ramp to 20%. Can someone confirm the watchlist includes `inference.error_rate`, `token_latency_p95`, and `cpu_pct`?

Alejandra: Confirmed — dashboard `prod/rollouts/smart-cache` has those metrics. I updated alert thresholds: `error_rate > 0.5%` OR `p95 > 250ms` will page. Also enabled 10% trace sampling for alpha slices to help debugging if needed.

Hassan: Root cause for the 503s looks like Nagle interactions on a few older nodes — draining and replacing 3 nodes now. No user-facing impact observed.

Maya: Great. If all stays green I'll trigger the 20% ramp at 00:45 UTC. Please react with :thumbsup: if you're OK or call out any objections.

Jordan: :thumbsup:

Sara: :thumbsup: Quality checks pass on a random set of prompts.

DeployBot: canary ramp to 20% scheduled at 1715559900 (00:45 UTC). rollback_on_failure=true.

Maya: Thanks team — I'll post a short follow-up once the 20% ramp completes or if anything changes.
